title: The Greedy merchant at the port
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：greedy　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 greedy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the warden wrote of ① a greedy merchant at the port in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② greedier than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the greedy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the greediest merchant at the port anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1942 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too greedy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the greedy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a greedy appetite of the boy, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as greedy as the appetite of the boy they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was greedy or not, and he said so.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something greedy, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite greedy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the greedy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958, twice over, she wrote of another greedy merchant at the port in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ greedier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The greediest appetite of the boy in the whole centre, she said in 1960, was the one she could never quite name; the greedy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 贪婪（前置定语 a greedy merchant at the port：1948 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件贪婪的商人）
B. adj. 贪婪／贪吃（比较级 greedier than：文中两处，一处比港口那个贪心的商人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 贪婪／贪吃（最高级 the greediest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 贪婪（表语 too greedy to do：母亲觉得它太贪婪，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 贪吃（前置定语 a greedy appetite of the boy：叔叔把整件事称作一桩贪吃的好胃口）
F. adj. 贪吃（同级比较 as greedy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩男孩的好胃口相比）
G. adj. 贪吃（后置定语 something greedy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 贪吃（受程度副词修饰 quite greedy：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a greedy merchant at the port
the greediest merchant at the port anybody
a greedy appetite of the boy
The greediest appetite of the boy in

answers.why: greedy 意为“贪婪”，1948 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件贪婪的商人”，此处作前置定语 a greedy merchant at the port。
greedy 意为“贪婪”，此处用比较级 greedier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
greedy 意为“贪婪”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最贪婪的一件，故用最高级 the greediest merchant at the port。
greedy 意为“贪婪”，母亲认为这件东西“太贪婪了，谁也用不上”，too greedy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
greedy 意为“贪吃”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩贪吃的好胃口”，此处作前置定语 a greedy appetite of the boy。
greedy 意为“贪吃”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩男孩的好胃口一样贪吃”，同级比较用 as greedy as。
greedy 意为“贪吃”，登记册上那半行字要的是“贪吃的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something greedy。
greedy 意为“贪吃”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当贪吃”，quite 修饰原级 greedy。
greedy 意为“贪吃”，1958 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要贪吃”，故用比较级 greedier than。
greedy 意为“贪吃”，母亲 1960 年说的是“整个社区中心里最贪吃的那一桩”，故用最高级 the greediest appetite of the boy。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件贪婪的商人。（a greedy merchant at the port）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更贪婪。（greedier than …）
母亲觉得它太贪婪，谁也用不上。（too greedy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩贪吃的好胃口。（a greedy appetite of the boy）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩男孩的好胃口一样贪吃。（as greedy as …）
到了 1955 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件贪吃的东西。（something greedy）
answers: In 1948 the warden wrote of a greedy merchant at the port in the register.
Everybody said it was greedier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too greedy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a greedy appetite of the boy.
He said nobody would call it as greedy as the appetite of the boy they had once had.
By 1955 the register asked for nothing but something greedy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 greedy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the warden wrote of a greedy merchant at the port in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the greediest merchant at the port in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too greedy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a greedy appetite of the boy, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite greedy, and everybody laughed.
The greedy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
